nom: Paula's Choice Skin Recovery Replenishing Moisturizer

avis.texte: This is a good moisturizer for dry skin, it’s thick but not too thick. The smell is a bit weird to me but I like the product so I’ll keep using it. I do have a sensitive nose so it might just be me, but I probably won’t purchase again.

It’s okay, the bottle size is great. I don’t like traveling with bulky things. The only problem I have is sometimes it makes my face sweat more. i’m not sure why.. I most likely won’t buy again because of that reason. I would say it is lightweight but I haven’t noticed a difference in my skin. It feels the same and hasn’t changed my skin texture at all.

avis.titre: Great if you’re using prescription retinoids
avis.texte: I don’t have dry skin generally, and I live in a humid climate, but the reason I keep getting this Paula’s Choice moisturizer is because I found it to be the best when using prescription retinoid at night to lock in hydration. You wake up in the morning and your skin still feels moisturized and comfortable. I used it during the retinalization period, too and it helped with irritation, redness and peeling. It has a rich texture and consistency, but it doesn’t apply heavy or greasy. It absorbs quickly. A little goes a long way, or at least that’s the case for me, but again, my skin is not dry. The skin stays moisturized all night long, too. I don’t use it every night during the hot and humid summers, but definitely every other night and have never had any issues or breakouts . I travel overseas rather frequently and I have also found it good for moisture retention on the long flights in the dry airplane air. Given how little it takes to cover the whole face and neck, I think this a good value for the money and especially since Amazon has it on sale often. I just purchased my 4th one.

I have used this moisturizer for many years and along the way I am always trying other moisturizers but NOTHING compares to this. I am obsessed with all of the Paula's Choice skincare line… they really are top quality and I have seen and felt the results. Worth the little extra money! Smells great too - light soothing smell… 🤍🤍

avis.titre: The most healing, moisturizing and effective Paula’s Choice
avis.texte: This thick and very rich formula is very nourishing and moisturizing. I use it on cold, windy days to protect my skin from damage. It would also work well as an overnight mask, leaving your skin soft and supple. This one takes a bit longer to absorb into the skin, so I would wait to put on sunscreen until it is.

avis.texte: I love this cream I started getting rosacea this has really helped my face and keep it moisturized

I’ve been using Paula’s Choice Azelaic Acid and have been so happy with the results, so I decided to try this moisturizer too. I’ve been on the hunt for a good face moisturizer, and this one has been fantastic! It’s rich and creamy, so I usually use it at night after my Azelaic Acid, but I’ll also use it before makeup when my skin needs a little extra hydration. It leaves my skin feeling soft and moisturized without feeling greasy.
Paulas choice is a go to for my skin. Its dry and sensitive This moisturizer lasts a long time. Its pricey but definitely worth it
Very moisturising. Not as hydrating as the mask but not as thick either if you're after a thinner moisturiser under makeup.
Lovely cream, feels thick but a little goes a long way - super moisturising and soothing, definitely a new favourite for the end of my skincare routine especially after a vit A
This night time moisturiser is fantastic. Paul's Choice is a wonderful range.

avis.titre: *THE* best moisturizer for sensitive, dry skin!
avis.texte: I have hypersensitive, dry skin and have struggled to find skincare products that don’t irritate it. This is my holy grail moisturizer. The formula is gentle, ultra-hydrating, and lightweight. It’s expensive for the size, but a little bit goes a long way.

avis.titre: Wonderful Face Lotion for Soft, Hydrated Skin!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this face lotion! It makes my skin feel incredibly soft and hydrated, and I appreciate that it contains clean ingredients. Although it's a thick moisturizer, it goes on smoothly without feeling heavy. My skin is usually very dry, but this lotion keeps it soft and moisturized. You only need a small amount, so it lasts a long time. Definitely worth the price!

Purchased this upon Paula’s Choice recommendation for rosacea (through their chat agent on their website). Amazon pricing was a little cheaper. I don’t feel this helped with my rosacea but it didn’t hurt it either. It didn’t feel like it absorbed very well and left my face feeling “clogged”, like I had a mask on all day… heavy and sometimes itchy. I don’t particularly like the feel of lotion on my skin so I’m picky. Sadly this is to heavy for me and since I didn’t see any redness reduction or moisturizing- I can’t see myself purchasing again. I prefer the lighter Invisible Finish Moisture Gel.

I used *Paula's Choice Hydralight Moisture-Infusing Lotion Moisturizer for Sensitive Rosacea Prone Oily Skin* for years, but applied only a small amount because my skin felt tender and dry. I never considered switching to *Paula's Choice--SKIN RECOVERY Replenishing Moisturizer Cream for Redness--Facial Moisturizer--Soothes Rosacea, Wrinkles, and Uneven Skin Tone* because I have combination skin. However, my dermatologist told me that because I have sensitive, acne-prone skin, I should give this product a try. I've never been so happy with an acne cream before. I apply a thin layer each night and my skin feels moisturized and soft. My adult acne has noticeably cleared up and my acne scars are fading.

My skin never looks it's best as when I put this stuff on daily! My skin is sooo PLUMP and moisturized!! It looks so clear and healthy, I've got to buy more of this stuff. The one thing I'm not into is the smell. I figure it's the evening primrose ingredient. It stinks. But if you don't mind the smell, the results are spectacular and a must-have for those who aim for clear, glowing skin!

I’m so disappointed to be writing this review. I waited a long time to purchase this due to its price. After using this moisturizer for a week, my skin is cracking, peeling and dry. When first applied, it left my skin feeling tingly and stinging. For such an expensive moisturizer that is supposed to be for sensitive skin, it did not deliver.

The AMAZING Paula’s Choice Hydrating Treatment Cream was sadly discontinued and Paula’s Choice is directing users towards this Paula’s Choice Replenishing Moisturizer which is absolutely NOTHING like the wonderful Hydrating Treatment Cream. This “Replenishing Moisturizer” is drying, and dries down to a waxy-feeling texture. This might be okay for younger people who want something under make up that isn’t emollient, but for older people this doesn’t cut it. I still have a few bottles left of my beloved Moisture Boost and I have no idea what I am going to do after that. BRING BACK MOISTURE BOOST HYDRATING TREATMENT CREAM PAULA’S CHOICE!!!!

I have rosacea, but have not had a flare up in a while. In fact, my skin has been very clear! I wanted to try a new moisturizer that was hydrating. After reading reviews and some skin care articles, this product was recommended. I applied it for ONE NIGHT and it has caused the worst reaction I have EVER experienced from a skin care product. This is not safe for sensitive skin… or any skin. I’m in so much pain, my face is itchy and on fire. I have to schedule a doctor’s appointment. I’m so disappointed as the description is extremely misleading- do not use!!!!!!!!
I bought the whole system used for about 3 weeks. Now my skin is drier than before and actually flaky. Disappointed
